about.titleStart: I photograph people the way they feel,
about.p1: For more than a decade I have been chasing honest light and quiet moments: a laugh in the middle of a celebration, a child's hand reaching for yours, a face in perfect window light.
about.p2: My work is calm, cinematic and made to be looked at for a lifetime. Every session is unhurried and every image is edited by hand.

works.title: Our Latest Works
works.subtitle: A selection of recent sessions - events, family & portraits, commercial and nature.

t1.quote: We open our photos every anniversary and cry every single time. Sandu saw moments we didn't even know had happened.
t1.author: Ana & Mihai

t2.quote: Calm, patient and so present. The portraits feel like me on my best day, without trying too hard.
t2.author: Elena R.

t3.quote: Receiving our private folder was like opening a present. Every single photograph felt considered.
t3.author: The Popescu family

t4.quote: Discreet all evening, and yet nothing was missed. Our guests still talk about the photos.
t4.author: Laura & Matteo

t5.quote: Professional from the first message to the final delivery. I would book again tomorrow.
t5.author: Julien M.
